574-2595-4694-7306.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
574-2595-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
574-2595-4694-7306.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat from step 2.
574-2595-4694-7306.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

955-3755-4770-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1445-1913-4247-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and an artifact creature card in your graveyard.
1445-1913-4247-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh the Stormlord triggers if the creature that was returned to your hand was an artifact, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

728-4871-5220-6594.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
728-4871-5220-6594.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1981-2415-3188-4247.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3188-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

6927-7694-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
6927-7694-8043.description:
Cast Multiversal Incursion for free due to Vision, creating a nonlegendary token copy of each nontoken creature you control.
When the Damage Control Crew token enters, it triggers, returning Multiversal Incursion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4574-4659-5034-5283-6842.notablePrerequisites: There must be at least one +1/+1 counter each on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts.
4574-4659-5034-5283-6842.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Inexorable Tide triggers, putting one +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts you control.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sol Ring, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Sol Ring from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate Iron Spider's last ability by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from artifacts you control, drawing Sol Ring.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4284-6913.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4284-6913.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Chameleon and Clone each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Chameleon trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Clone trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4284-6913.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

475-549-3197-4017.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-549-3197-4017.description:
Gain life in any way.
Herd Baloth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-5359-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk.
When Threefold Thunderhulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters, it triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Golem artifact creature tokens equal to its power.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

500-1777-3191-3908.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Spark Double and creating two token copies of it that are nonlegendary copies of Kairi.
When Spark Double dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing one of the Spark Double tokens.
When the token dies, it triggers. Choose either mode.
Resolve Burnt Offering, adding {B}{B}{B/R}{B/R}{B/R}{B/R}
Resolve the Spark Double trigger from step 5, causing you to mill six cards and return Saw in Half and Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat
500-1777-3191-3908.notes: You can forego casting Burnt Offering if you have enough black mana. This'll allow you to net creature tokens. The additional Kairi trigger in step 4 can be used to put all instants and sorceries from your library and graveyard into your hand, or to bounce permanents.

907-1558-3875-4231-5184.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Xorn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2539-3094-3480-4659-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2539-3094-3480-4659-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

240-2034-5470-6965.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {C}{C}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4747-7282-7340.notablePrerequisites: You had a creature with power 5 or greater enter the battlefield this turn.
4747-7282-7340.description:
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Alena.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2981-6972-7158.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Arcbound Slasher.
When Arcbound Slasher dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Slasher's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Slasher from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

2034-4871-5496-6000-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Sapphire Medallion.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6199-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Marionette Apprentice.
When Marionette Apprentice dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Marionette Apprentice enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2173-5147-5220-6539.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Willow Geist.
When Willow Geist dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Willow Geist from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Willow Geist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast Willow Geist from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

1170-1414-4708-6862.easyPrerequisites: One of the artifacts must be in your hand, while the other is either in your graveyard or in your library.
1170-1414-4708-6862.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Delivery Moogle.
When Delivery Moogle enters, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the other artifact and putting it into your hand.
Activate the artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

4222-6723-6858.description:
Activate Oreskos Sun Guide by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Oreskos Sun Guide.
Oreskos Sun Guide triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

539-2783-2921-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Nesting Dragon triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1329-1492-3338.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1329-1492-3338.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Welding Jar.
Cast Welding Jar from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

654-1170-3389-5954-6751.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1558-4231-4508.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Pirates that do not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by at least two opponents.
1558-4231-4508.description:
Deal combat damage to two opponents using at least two Pirates.
Malcolm triggers, creating at least two Treasure, Food and Clue tokens.
Activate TIme Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
1558-4231-4508.notes: Once you only have one opponent remaining, this combo will no longer make the necessary resources to sustain itself.

222-527-647-2292.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-647-2292.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Staff of Domination

290-661-1651-2645.description:
Activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Sculpting Steel and Staff of Domination, untapping Dreamstone Hedron.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Activate Sculpting Steel's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

5342-5605.manaNeeded: {6}{B}{B} at most plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
5342-5605.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a life total of 40 or higher.
5342-5605.description:
Cast Torgaar either from your hand or from the command zone by paying at most {6}{B}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Torgaar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose an amount of life equal to at least their life total.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

549-703-1270-2034-2637.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating six token copies of Mechtitan Core that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two of the Mechtitan Core tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate a Mechtitan Core by paying {5} and exiling it, three other Mechtitan Core tokens, and Astral Dragon, creating three 10/10 Mechtitan legendary creature tokens.
Put all but one of the Mechtitan tokens in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Mechtitan Core triggers twice, returning all cards exiled to create the Mechtitan tokens from exile to the battlefield.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mechtitan, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating six token copies of Mechtitan Core that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite {C}, you may forego sacrificing Mechtitan Core tokens to Ashnod's Altar, and then target any other applicable permanents using Astral Dragon.

662-4049-4836-5159.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Hesitation to become an artifact until end of turn.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Hesitation that is a 4/4 artifact creature named Mishra's Warform in addition to its other types.
At the beginning of your end step, Mishra's Warform triggers, causing you to fail to sacrifice Mishra's Warform due to The Master.
Whenever a player casts a spell, Mishra's Warform triggers, countering that spell and causing you to fail to sacrifice it due to The Master.
Repeat step 4 as necessary.

uses.exileCardState: exiled by Eye of the Storm
exiled by Eye of the Storm

4036-4293-4398.notablePrerequisites:
An additional instant or sorcery with flashback and with mana cost {R}{R}{R}{R}{R} or less in hand or graveyard.
Enough mana available to cast the additional spell.
4036-4293-4398.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery spell with flashback by paying its cost.
Eye of the Storm triggers, exiling that card, then allowing you to cast copies of all spells exiled with Eye of the Storm.
Resolve the Seething Song copy, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Runic Repetition copy, returning the card you cast in step 1 from exile to your hand.
Resolve all other spell copies.
Repeat.

2781-4753.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Clever Impersonator.
2781-4753.description:
Cast Clever Impersonator by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Clever Impersonator enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Clever Impersonator. Choose to have Clever Impersonator enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

1040-1486-2742-3809.notablePrerequisites: Duergar Mine-Captain does not have summoning sickness.
1040-1486-2742-3809.description:
Tap Duergar Mine-Captain to Kyren Negotiations to deal 1 damage.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Tap and sacrifice that token for {1}{R/W}.
Pay {1}{R/W} and untap Duergar Mine-Captain to give attacking creatures you control +1/+0.
Repeat

262-1086-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Famished Paladin.
262-1086-3957.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to create 3 1/1 creature tokens with haste.
The token ETBs, triggering Anionter Priest three times, gaining you 1 life each time.
Famished Paladin triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for infinite creature tokens.

2816-3099-4667.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Elvish Aberration.
Elvish Aberration does not have summoning sickness.
2816-3099-4667.description:
Activate Elvish Aberration by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Mantle by paying {3}, untapping Elvish Aberration.
Repeat.
